integrity: A self-contained constructive proof and explicit obstruction with reproducible finite cross-checks; finite tests do not prove all orders. Independent external validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Identical binary additive valuations and nonempty connected parts; the ternary negative witness holds for k at least four. No claim for heterogeneous valuations, outer-item EF1, or general valuation alphabets.
title: Binary connected EF1 spectra and a ternary gap on friendship graphs
